An adventure to find the ultimate legendary card!
description:
An adventure to find the ultimate legendary card hidden in the Wind Forest!

The mysterious 'Wind Forest' where external cards do not work at all.
Start with basic monster cards alongside your guide, 'Kumira', and build your ultimate deck!
Collect and enhance monsters across four elemental attributes (Water, Fire, Wood, Iron) with unique character abilities, and overcome the trials of villains and guardian deities threatening the Wind Forest.

Key Features
Intuitive one-button timing battles played with just a single finger!
Tap the matching elemental icon according to the rotating circular gauge!
Claim the initiative with precise timing and deliver fatal strikes utilizing elemental matchups.

4 Elements and Deep Elemental Matchup Strategy
Clear matchup relationships among the four elements: Water, Fire, Wood, and Iron!
Strategic fun in analyzing enemy attributes to build decks with advantageous element monsters.

Fun of Collection and Growth (From Rank C to Rank S!)
Monster card crafting, card rank upgrades, level enhancement, and transcendence!
Equip Hole Stones (Enhancement Stones) to grant unique skills (Rage, Crazy, Reflect, Absorb, Heal, etc.) and train them to be stronger.
Uncapped cumulative stat boosts upon acquiring duplicates!

Unique Character Stat Development
Each character possesses diverse trait stats such as Critical Chance, Evasion Rate, and EXP Boost!
Enhance character stats in your preferred direction to match your playstyle.

Rich Content and Complete Index
20 basic monsters per element and golden 'Legendary Hidden Monsters' with special abilities!
Mining system, various achievement rewards, plus Guardian Battles and showdowns against character doppelgangers that test your limits!
